maddeler.e:
ينتبهان (form VIII)
# يَنْتَبِهَانِ (yantabihāni) /jan.ta.bi.haː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# يُنْتَبَهَانِ (yuntabahāni) /jun.ta.ba.haː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
